subject: Request: >20% hosted API concession for Medexia / urgent budget gap
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medexia.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medexia.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Budget request — need 25% concession to close (Medexia)

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We're running final budget approvals this week and I've hit a hard cap on unit economics for the Hosted API. Leadership has asked me to see if Redwood can accommodate a 25% off list unit rate for the first 12 months to make the numbers work for our fiscal Q1 start.

Concretes: based on our forecast, we expect 18M tokens/month in month 3, ramping to ~30M/month by month 6. The ask is a 25% off the standard hosted usage rate for 12 months in exchange for a signed SOW + PO by 2028-10-20 and a 12-month committed term.

We're ready to sign quickly if we can land this concession — happy to share internal approval notes if helpful. Can you advise whether this needs an executive exception and how quickly you can escalate?

Attachments: Medexia_budget_summary.pdf (attached)

Samir
Head of Procurement
Medexia
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medexia.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget request — need 25% concession to close (Medexia)

Samir — thanks for the clarity and for the numbers. Appreciate the urgency. I'm going to run this up to deal desk + our revenue leadership for emergency review.

Quick ask: can you confirm the committed monthly minimum you'd sign to lock the concession? If you can share the PO template we'll coordinate with finance. Will update you by end of day tomorrow.

—Evelyn
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Medexia — request for 25% hosted rate concession (need exec signoff)

Ben / Jonas —

Medexia (strategic healthcare data partner) is asking for a 25% concession on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months to meet a procurement cap. They will execute SOW + PO by 2028-10-20 if we can meet price. Key points:
- Forecast: 18M tokens/mo (month 3) -> 30M tokens/mo (month 6) -> plateau at ~28–35M tokens
- They want 12-month committed term; willing to provide standard PO and legal redlines are light (mostly SLAs and data residency clauses)
- Strategic rationale: large reference account in US health market, potential expansion into dedicated within 9–12 months, marketplace co-sell opportunity

Economics I calculated roughly: at list rates this would be ~$Xk/mo; 25% concession impact on ARR ~-Y% but payback via expansion/tactical ref.

Ask: need senior pricing authorization to grant 25% for first 12 months. If full 25% isn't acceptable, alternatives to propose to customer: 22% for 12 months with a 12-month auto-renew at list, or 25% with an 18-month committed term and recovery clause.

I've attached the latest usage forecast and the redline SOW we're expecting. Please advise next steps — legal will need the signed direction for Docusign generation.

Attachments: usage_forecast_Q4.xlsx; Medexia_SOW_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Evelyn
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: Medexia — request for 25% hosted rate concession (need exec signoff)

Evelyn / team —

I reviewed the numbers — this is a large early-volume ramp and could be strategic. Two conditions I'd recommend if leadership is inclined to approve 25%:
1) 12-month minimum commitment with upfront PO for at least the first 3 months;
2) Clear auto-renew to list rates unless we negotiate a successor concession;
3) No add-on credits for first contract year; any pilot credits are reconciled before signing.

If leadership won't approve 25% outright, propose 22% for 12 months with the same commitment — that protects unit economics and closes faster. I've attached a short deal_summary.pdf with margin sensitivity.

Ben
Sr. Director, Deal Desk
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 14:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Medexia — request for 25% hosted rate concession (need exec signoff)

Team —

Authorize the 25% hosted API concession for Medexia for the first 12 months subject to the following non-negotiable conditions:
- Legal to approve SOW redlines (no changes to indemnity or data residency beyond our standard clauses)
- PO executed and funds committed for first 3 months prior to discount activation
- Contract to include auto-renew at standard list rates after month 12 (no evergreen concession)
- No stacked credits; any pilot credits must be consumed/offset before signing

Please proceed to get legal & finance sign-off ASAP and prepare DocuSign with these conditions. I'll be copied on the final sign-off email. This is a strategic win; close with those guardrails.

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medexia.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medexia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget request — need 25% concession to close (Medexia)

Samir / Olivia — great news: leadership has approved a 25% concession for the first 12 months under the conditions below.

Conditions (summary):
- 25% off hosted usage unit rates for months 1–12
- Signed SOW + PO by 2028-10-20; finance requires PO for first 3 months before discount appliation
- Contract will auto-renew to list rates after month 12; no additional credits during the concession period
- Legal to confirm the redline SOW (we expect standard language)

Next steps: I'm attaching the SOW (v3) and the usage forecast for reference. I'll have Legal generate a DocuSign this afternoon reflecting the approved concession and conditions — you'll receive the DocuSign link. Once we have a signed SOW and PO we can turn on the concession and schedule onboarding.

Attachments: Medexia_SOW_v3.pdf; usage_forecast_Q4.xlsx; deal_summary.pdf

Thanks — excited to get this across the line.

—Evelyn
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
